case.title: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o., Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH. RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series. Need: 4200 pc a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 35 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: lead_time_days <= 42. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is good to hear from you again. For this work, we can offer a price of €36.00 per unit. We have our CNC machines ready and look forward to putting this job onto the shop floor for you. 

Let me know if this works for you so we can get started soon.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Dear Mr Dralveck,

You wrote that your CNC machines are ready and that you want to get this job onto the shop floor. Option A is built for a shop that wants work on its machines, and it gives you a clear price, a payment term and a lead time to plan around.

Several bidders are competing for the HX pump shaft, and the award goes to the best package. We cannot promise it in advance.

On quality:
Your quality was 1863 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70210@2026Q3).

On the competition:
Another supplier has offered EUR 31.50 for this part (offer:70240-0).

On material costs:
German producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.1% from 2026-05 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

Option A is the package we can approve. Quality, a competing offer and falling bar prices all point to the same place, and it is the one term sheet that reflects them.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 26.61; payment 14 days net; lead time 35 days.

We would like to work with a family company we know, and we ask you to look at Option A closely and send us your best offer.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. Hallo, I checked your numbers and the 14 days payment is good for us. I can do 30.00 EUR with 14 days payment and 35 days lead time, let's get this going. Our current Angebot is a price of €30.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Dear Mr Dralveck,

You wrote "let's get this going", and Option A is built to do exactly that: it gives your shop a clear payment term and a lead time to plan around.

Option A is the package we can approve. It keeps the payment term and lead time you proposed, and it comes with a price we can take forward. Several bidders are still competing for the HX pump shaft, and the award goes to the best package. We cannot promise it in advance.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 26.87; payment 14 days net; lead time 35 days.

It is a clean basis for the HX shaft work, with no further terms to settle.

Please take Option A to the person who approves it, and let us know the outcome.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:

For our offer, we can do a price of €28.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days. I can do 28.00 EUR with the 14 days payment, let's get this on the machines.

messages.subject: Quote from Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very eager to work together with you and to prove ourselves as a reliable, long-term partner for your business!

We are happy to offer you a price of €31.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 52 days. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We really look forward to hearing from you soon and hope we can start a great cooperation!

Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Dear Ms Procházková,

You wrote that you want to prove yourselves as a reliable, long-term partner. Option A is built for that: it gives you the longest payment term of our three options, and a clear, planned relationship for the new HX series.

Two points frame our response. On quality:

Your quality was 980 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70240@2026Q3).

On the alloy surcharge:

The alloy surcharge for stainless grade 316L changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 25.99; payment 90 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 25.84; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option C: unit price EUR 25.76; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.

Option A is the package we can approve, because it answers both points above while giving you the planning security you are looking for.

Several bidders are competing for this RFQ. The award goes to the best overall package, and we cannot promise it in advance.

Please take Option A to your management as it stands. It gives Strojírna Hrvelec a firm place in the HX series, a defined price and a payment term that supports your planning.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. I checked the alloy surcharge and the quality ppm you mentioned, and you are right, so I can drop the price a bit. I took your Option C with 45 days payment, but 35 days lead time is just too tight for us, so I have to change it back to 52 days. With that, I can offer you 31.00 EUR. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351.

Our offer is a price of €34.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days.

Alternatively, at our standard terms, a price of €31.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 52 days.

Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 52 days: €31.00 per unit.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.

Quality Manager: We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.
